title: Pointers
goal: Address, dereference, NULL, pointer arithmetic, const variants aur segfault ko memory maps ke saath samajhna.
definition: Pointer ek variable hai jo doosre object ka memory address store karta hai. Uska type batata hai ki dereference par kitni bytes kaunsa type padhna hai.
explain: & operator address deta hai, * operator us address par value (lvalue) deta hai. int *p = &x; *p = 5; se x badal jaata hai.
Pointer ka size platform par depend karta hai (64-bit par 8 bytes), type se nahi. Type arithmetic aur dereference ke liye hai.
NULL pointer kisi object ko point nahi karta — dereference karna crash/UB. Wild pointer uninitialized hota hai; dangling pointer free ya scope khatam hone ke baad bacha rehta hai.
Pointer arithmetic type ke size se scaled hoti hai: int *p me p+1 = p + sizeof(int) bytes. Sirf same array ke andar valid hai.
const int *p = value read-only; int *const p = pointer khud fix; const int *const p = dono fix.
analogy: Pointer ek address ki parchi hai: parchi par ghar ka address likha hai, ghar nahi. Parchi badalna (pointer reassign) aur ghar ke andar saaman badalna (*p = ...) alag cheezein hain.
why: Pointers C ka superpower aur sabse bada khatra hain: inke bina dynamic memory, strings-as-parameters aur data structures possible nahi; inki galti se segfault aur security bugs aate hain.

syntax.note: p+1 next element par jaata hai, next byte par nahi.

syntax.code:
const int *a;      /* value const */
int *const b = &x;  /* pointer const */
const int *const c = &x; /* dono */

topics.title: Address aur dereference
topics.body: &x se address, *p se value. Pointer ko print karne ke liye %p + (void*) cast. Address values run se run badalte hain — unhe hardcode mat karo.

topics.title: NULL, void, wild, dangling
topics.body: int *p = NULL; dereference se pehle check. void* generic address hai — arithmetic nahi, cast karke use karo. Wild: initialize karo. Dangling: free ke baad NULL set karo.

topics.title: Pointer arithmetic aur pointer-to-pointer
topics.body: p+i, p-i, p2-p1 (elements ka difference). Comparison same array me meaningful. int **pp do level ka indirection hai — function me pointer modify karne ke liye.

topics.title: Functions aur const
topics.body: Pointer se function original badal sakta hai. const correctness se accidental modification pakdi jaati hai. Function pointer: int (*fp)(int,int).

topics.title: Segfault debugging
topics.body: NULL deref, freed memory, out-of-bounds, stack overflow — ASan se exact line milti hai. gdb me bt aur print *p.

lines: p x ka address rakhta hai; *p se value.
*p = 15 se x hi badal jaata hai.
swap addresses leta hai, isliye originals badalte hain.

set_null pointer ko NULL set karta hai — double pointer chahiye.

mistakes.why: Uninitialized pointer kisi bhi address par likh sakta hai — crash/UB.
Arithmetic type-size se scaled hoti hai.

debug.brief: Program segfault kar raha hai. Reason dhundo.
hints: p kis address par point karta hai?
Pehle real int ka address do.

best: Pointer initialize karo ya NULL do
free ke baad NULL set karo

interview.a: Wo pointer jo already free ho chuki ya scope se bahar gayi memory ko point karta hai. Dereference UB hai. Free ke baad NULL set karo.
interview.followUp: Detect? — ASan use-after-free report deta hai.

interview.a: const int *p: value read-only, pointer badal sakte ho. int *const p: pointer fix, value badal sakte ho. const int *const p: dono.
interview.followUp: Declaration kaise padhein? — right to left.
